The watch is a Jaeger-LeCoultre Master Control Date, steel, silver dial, with blue seconds hand, on a tan leather strap. Reference Q1548530 (or 1548530) — Master Control Date 40mm steel. Actually the Master Control Date with blue seconds hand and sunray silver dial is reference Q1548530 (also Q1548470?). Let me think.

JLC Master Control Date 40mm steel, silver dial, blue seconds hand — reference 1548530 (Q1548530). Also known as Q1548530. Yes, the Master Control Date reference Q1548530 has a silvered dial with blue second hand. Actually I recall Q1548530 being 39mm... The Master Control Date (2017+) is 40mm, ref Q1548530 with silver dial, blue seconds. There's also Q1548470 (Master Control Date with black dial?). Hmm.

JLC Master Control Date references: 1548530 (steel, silver dial, blue seconds, leather strap). Also 1548420 was the older Master Control Date 39mm. The 40mm version: Q1548530. I'll go with Q1548530, confidence ~0.5.

Movement: automatic (Calibre 899). Case material: stainless steel. Bracelet: leather.

Model family: Master Control Date.

Confidence ~0.5.
